payload.reason: The evidence indicates that encoders pretrained on artificial languages can be transferred to natural language tasks without parameter updates, and various downstream tasks have been tested in this context.

claims.text: Encoders pretrained on artificial languages have been tested on downstream tasks in natural language, such as natural language inference and question answering.
The Test for Inductive Bias via Language Model Transfer (TILT) framework has been used to evaluate the transferability of encoders to various tasks without parameter updates.
